page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-8-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4n family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 30.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 3.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance includes a local NVMe SSD for high-speed scratch space, though it does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses or hardware GPU accelerators.

Operating with dedicated CPU allocation, this server type delivers predictable compute performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core configurations. The inclusion of a local NVMe SSD provides low-latency storage access directly attached to the hypervisor, which enhances I/O operations compared to standard network-attached storage. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4n-standard-8-lssd balances compute capabilities and memory capacity, making it a viable option for workloads requiring dedicated resources and local storage without the overhead of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated instances.

This hardware profile is designed for general-purpose workloads, small-scale database hosting, web serving, and development environments that benefit from dedicated CPU execution and local NVMe SSD storage.
